declared: 2026-11-08, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes. These shapes reduce census 8's fourth diagnostic record (core's `const impl<T: [const] Destruct, F> Drop for array::Drain`, whose `NonNull<T>` field holds `pattern_type!(*const T is !null)`); their drafts in obj/parallel/census-batch7/repro/g were run through rustc 1.98.0 and this compiler before this declaration, so this is a regression record of that exploration. Each outcome follows the stated rule (a pattern type is `[const] Destruct` exactly when its base type is)

pattern-field.rs.reason: a const Drop impl's field is `pattern_type!(*const T is !null)`, whose raw pointer base is trivially const-destructible

nonnull-field.rs.reason: core's NonNull shape wraps that pattern field in a transparent struct

drain-fields.rs.reason: core's array Drain field shapes: NonNull, a raw pointer, a mutable reference and PhantomData

pointer-base-unbounded.rs.reason: the raw pointer base needs no `T: [const] Destruct`

parameter-base-bounded.rs.reason: a pattern over a type parameter base is const-destructible under `T: [const] Destruct`

parameter-base-unbounded.rs.reason: opponent: without that bound the pattern over a type parameter base is not `[const] Destruct` (E0367)
